title: Follow the Dollar
note: SAMPLE DATA. Structure follows the Miami-Dade County adopted budget, but every figure, edge and citation is unverified until marked verified: true.

sources.name: Countywide property tax
sources.blurb: Paid by property owners across the whole county.
sources.restriction: Countywide property tax revenue goes into the Countywide General Fund.
sources.citation: SAMPLE, to verify: Miami-Dade County FY 2026-27 Adopted Budget and Multi-Year Capital Plan, Vol. 1, Revenue Summary (page to confirm)

sources.name: Fire Rescue District property tax
sources.blurb: A separate property tax in the area Fire Rescue serves.
sources.restriction: The fire district tax can only pay for Fire Rescue.
sources.citation: SAMPLE, to verify: Miami-Dade County FY 2026-27 Adopted Budget and Multi-Year Capital Plan, Vol. 2, Fire Rescue (page to confirm)

sources.name: Library District property tax
sources.blurb: A separate property tax in the area the county libraries serve.
sources.restriction: The library district tax can only pay for the county library system.
sources.citation: SAMPLE, to verify: Miami-Dade County FY 2026-27 Adopted Budget and Multi-Year Capital Plan, Vol. 2, Library (page to confirm)

sources.name: Half-cent sales tax (county share)
sources.blurb: A share of the state sales tax sent back to the county.
sources.restriction: The county's share of the half-cent sales tax goes to its two general funds.
sources.citation: SAMPLE, to verify: Miami-Dade County FY 2026-27 Adopted Budget and Multi-Year Capital Plan, Vol. 1, Revenue Summary; Fla. Stat. 218.60-218.67 (page to confirm)

sources.name: Transit surtax (half-penny)
sources.blurb: A half-cent sales surtax voters approved in 2002 for transportation.
sources.restriction: The transit surtax can only pay for transportation under the People's Transportation Plan.
sources.citation: SAMPLE, to verify: Miami-Dade County FY 2026-27 Adopted Budget and Multi-Year Capital Plan, Vol. 2, Transportation and Public Works; Fla. Stat. 212.055(1) (page to confirm)

sources.name: Water and sewer bills
sources.blurb: What customers pay for water and sewer service.
sources.restriction: Water bill revenue can only pay for the water and sewer system.
sources.citation: SAMPLE, to verify: Miami-Dade County FY 2026-27 Adopted Budget and Multi-Year Capital Plan, Vol. 3, Water and Sewer (page to confirm)

sources.name: Garbage and trash fees
sources.blurb: Household collection fees and disposal fees.
sources.restriction: Garbage fees can only pay for trash collection and disposal.
sources.citation: SAMPLE, to verify: Miami-Dade County FY 2026-27 Adopted Budget and Multi-Year Capital Plan, Vol. 3, Solid Waste Management (page to confirm)

sources.name: Airport fees and rents
sources.blurb: Landing fees, terminal rents and concessions at MIA and the county's general aviation airports.
sources.restriction: Federal rules require airport revenue to stay at the airport.
sources.citation: SAMPLE, to verify: Miami-Dade County FY 2026-27 Adopted Budget and Multi-Year Capital Plan, Vol. 3, Aviation; 49 U.S.C. 47107(b) (page to confirm)

sources.name: Seaport fees
sources.blurb: Cruise passenger fees, cargo fees and rents at PortMiami.
sources.restriction: Seaport fees can only pay for PortMiami.
sources.citation: SAMPLE, to verify: Miami-Dade County FY 2026-27 Adopted Budget and Multi-Year Capital Plan, Vol. 3, Seaport (page to confirm)

sources.name: Tourist and restaurant taxes
sources.blurb: Hotel room taxes plus the food and beverage tax on some restaurant sales.
sources.restriction: Tourist and restaurant taxes can only go to uses state law lists, like culture, tourism and homeless services.
sources.citation: SAMPLE, to verify: Miami-Dade County FY 2026-27 Adopted Budget and Multi-Year Capital Plan, Vol. 1; Fla. Stat. 125.0104 and 212.0306 (page to confirm)

funds.name: Countywide General Fund
funds.blurb: Pays for services the county provides to everyone, in cities and unincorporated areas alike.
funds.restriction: Departments with their own dedicated tax or fee, like water, the airport or the library, are not paid from the Countywide General Fund.
funds.citation: SAMPLE, to verify: Miami-Dade County FY 2026-27 Adopted Budget and Multi-Year Capital Plan, Vol. 1, Fund Structure (page to confirm)

funds.name: UMSA General Fund
funds.blurb: Pays for local services in the Unincorporated Municipal Service Area, the parts of the county outside any city.
funds.restriction: The UMSA General Fund only pays for local services in unincorporated areas, like police patrol, local parks and code enforcement.
funds.citation: SAMPLE, to verify: Miami-Dade County FY 2026-27 Adopted Budget and Multi-Year Capital Plan, Vol. 1, Fund Structure (page to confirm)

funds.name: Fire Rescue District Fund
funds.restriction: Fire district money can only go to Fire Rescue.
funds.citation: SAMPLE, to verify: Miami-Dade County FY 2026-27 Adopted Budget and Multi-Year Capital Plan, Vol. 1, Fund Structure (page to confirm)

funds.name: Library District Fund
funds.restriction: Library district money can only go to the library system.
funds.citation: SAMPLE, to verify: Miami-Dade County FY 2026-27 Adopted Budget and Multi-Year Capital Plan, Vol. 1, Fund Structure (page to confirm)

funds.name: People's Transportation Plan Fund
funds.restriction: Surtax money can only go to transit and transportation projects.
funds.citation: SAMPLE, to verify: Miami-Dade County FY 2026-27 Adopted Budget and Multi-Year Capital Plan, Vol. 1, Fund Structure (page to confirm)

funds.name: Water and Sewer Enterprise Fund
funds.restriction: The Water and Sewer fund can only pay for the water and sewer system.
funds.citation: SAMPLE, to verify: Miami-Dade County FY 2026-27 Adopted Budget and Multi-Year Capital Plan, Vol. 1, Fund Structure (page to confirm)

funds.name: Solid Waste Enterprise Fund
funds.restriction: The Solid Waste fund can only pay for trash collection and disposal.
funds.citation: SAMPLE, to verify: Miami-Dade County FY 2026-27 Adopted Budget and Multi-Year Capital Plan, Vol. 1, Fund Structure (page to confirm)

funds.name: Aviation Enterprise Fund
funds.restriction: Airport money has to stay at the airport under federal law.
funds.citation: SAMPLE, to verify: Miami-Dade County FY 2026-27 Adopted Budget and Multi-Year Capital Plan, Vol. 1, Fund Structure (page to confirm)

funds.name: Seaport Enterprise Fund
funds.restriction: Seaport money can only be spent on PortMiami.

funds.name: Tourist and Food and Beverage Tax Funds

funds.citation: SAMPLE, to verify: Miami-Dade County FY 2026-27 Adopted Budget and Multi-Year Capital Plan, Vol. 1, Fund Structure (page to confirm)
